shown.message:
I requested changes on `paper-repo`#10 at head `43f17aa`. The one hold is length: the main text runs two lines onto page 10.

- **Checks:** `hutian/delivery` and `hutian/document` pass, and `code/README.md` and `paper/main.tex` are in the candidate. The three template files are byte-identical to the official template.
- **Length:** I read the `dev` build, which has the same head as the candidate; there is no `pull-10` build yet. The "Code and data" paragraph starts at the bottom of page 9, and its last two lines fall on page 10 before the References heading. NeurIPS 2026 does not review a submission over 9 pages of main text.
- **Request:** cut about three lines, or move detail from that paragraph to the appendix or the checklist. Then confirm on the system-built PDF, not a local build, that the main text ends on page 9 or earlier. I will re-review the new head.
- **Other checks:** the paper is US Letter, the checklist follows the references, and main-text sizes are 7 pt or larger apart from math scripts.
- **Open note:** the Type 3 font `F53` is still there.

I also commented on `paper-repo`#9 and am keeping it open until the build shows the fix.
